name: Constitutional Impact and Recovery Index
purpose: Convert divergence and funding misalignment into measurable harm, recovery potential, and restored participation.
description: CIRI models the downstream human and economic consequences of divergence. It translates validated authority conflicts and fiscal exposure into recovery metrics that can be used by CIBS, CII, Integration, and Macro.

inputs.name: intake_artifact
inputs.description: Original user-provided source text, file metadata, jurisdiction, and source type.

inputs.name: cda_artifact
inputs.description: Constitutional divergence analysis including divergence score, findings, indicators, and authority trace.

inputs.name: cff_artifact
inputs.description: Funding fidelity output including ON_MISSION, OFF_MISSION, and UNCLEAR conditions.

inputs.name: affe_artifact
inputs.description: Applied fiscal and financial exposure output including estimated economic harm.

outputs.name: ciri_score
outputs.description: Primary recovery-index score derived from divergence conditions.

outputs.name: cases_avoided
outputs.description: Modeled number of enforcement or prosecution events avoided through lawful realignment.

outputs.name: jail_days_avoided
outputs.description: Modeled number of detention or incarceration days avoided.

outputs.name: participation_restored
outputs.description: Estimated restored civic and economic participation.

outputs.name: net_modeled_recovery
outputs.description: Modeled recoverable value created by eliminating divergence.

state_transitions.description: Transforms validated divergence into measurable social and economic harm.
Converts quantified harm into recoverable value, restored participation, and avoided losses.

citizen_value.plain_language_role: Explains what the divergence means in real-world human terms and what recovery becomes possible when the divergence is removed.
